main.description: A bookmark: the author files a URL, DOI or content hash under tags, with an optional title and note. Filing is not endorsing (that is monster.attest.vote). One per author per subject; the record key is a base32 sha256 of the subject; writing again updates it; delete to remove.

subject.description: What is bookmarked: a normalised https URL, a doi: URI or a sha256: URI.

tags.description: Lowercase words; letters, digits and hyphens.

signatures.description: Inline signatures per the ATProtocol Attestation Specification; attest requires one from the author's device key.
